entries.name: Barbell Incline Shoulder Raise
entries.reason: Own drawn frames on The reclined incline chain (the trunk bearing 52 degrees; spine 23.92, neck 9.00, thigh 22.06, shin 22.49 exact) with the drawn bench answering how the equipment is used. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a barbell incline shoulder raise thr

frames.caption: Take the bar in the set grip with the rack behind. Set the shoulder blades before anything moves.
Lead the rep through the elbows on a soft bend.
Carry the arms through the intended arc to shoulder height.
Hold the top with the shoulder position set.
Lower with the same smooth path.
